identity.title: ALMA Observations of the IRDC Clump G34.43+00.24 MM3: 278 GHz Class I Methanol Masers

paper_type_evidence.quote: This Letter is the first ALMA observation reported for a millimeter class I methanol maser.

redshift_or_distance.value: 1.56 kpc (VLBI parallax); 3-4 kpc from other methods

evidence.quote: we have studied the relationship between class I methanol maser emission and dense molecular gas toward G34.43+00.24 MM3 at sub-arcsecond resolution

analysis_steps.goal: Excitation temperature from line ratios to test inversion

method.value: Tex from intensity ratios at 9-8 E peak velocity; negative Tex indicates population inversion

evidence.quote: Assuming optically thin emission and local thermodynamic equilibrium excitation, we calculate the excitation temperature from the intensity ratios

validation.value: Compared with thermal 5-4 E lines and hot core Tex of 79 K

evidence.loc: Results, Integrated Intensity Images and Spectra
evidence.quote: At this position, the excitation temperature derived from the ($9_{-1}$–$8_0$ $E$)/($5_0$-$4_0$ $E$) ratio is 79 K. Thus, maser emission is either absent or very weak toward the hot core.

findings_qualitative.value: No continuum or infrared point sources toward the maser peaks

evidence.quote: it is clear that there are no continuum peaks toward M1-M6

claims.experiment: Compared with 5-4 E lines assuming LTE
claims.result: Negative Tex at 6 peaks, narrow and compact

evidence.quote: The compact distribution, the narrow velocity width, and the population inversion indicate that the observed CH$_3$OH $J_K$ = $9_{-1}$–$8_0$ $E$ emission is maser emission.

claims.hypothesis: Masers arise from outflow-ambient gas interaction
claims.experiment: Channel maps and PV diagrams with CS, SiO, N2H+
claims.result: Peaks on edges of N2H+ and coincident with CS/SiO
claims.finding: Masers come from post-shocked gas at interaction regions

evidence.quote: We have clearly shown that the CH$_3$OH $J_K$=$9_{-1}$–$8_0$ masers arise from the post shocked gas in the interacting regions between the outflows and ambient dense gas.

claims.finding: Traces relatively old or weak shocks

evidence.quote: This indicates that the CH$_3$OH maser emission traces relatively old shocks or weak shocks.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radiative heating by embedded protostars rejected for M5 due to no continuum sources

evidence.quote: Thus, the CH$_3$OH molecule in M5 cannot originate from radiative heating by embedded protostars.

limitations_admitted.value: Unclear whether maser can persist after shock ended; driving source unclear

evidence.quote: However, it is unclear whether the maser emission can be maintained for a relatively long timescale after the shock ended.

referee_caveats_inferred: Tex from LTE optically thin ratios is not valid for masers; only a sign test
